spec.thirds: within-group pct rank of P: SP_hi > 2/3, SP_lo <= 1/3; weak_pulled = weak & P pct > 2/3
spec.excess: group mean fwd(t+1 open -> t+1+h open) minus eligible mean, %p, date-averaged; NW t lag=h
spec.primary: diff SP_hi - SP_lo at h=10, pick front best, confirm on back
spec.search_size: 36 combos x 3 h x 4 windows x 5 metrics (double sort) + 51 rankers (harness.evaluate)
spec.cost_note: one-way 0.1% spread = 0.2%p per round trip; SP_hi vs SP_lo diff is cost-neutral when choosing between two buys
